nodes.label: Fixed Event-to-Output Latency Guarantee
nodes.rationale: Asynchronous external inputs require synchronization (2-flop), so the guarantee is stated as fixed cycles after the *synchronized* event — not instantaneous. This makes the latency provable and data-independent regardless of other active contexts.

nodes.label: Open-Drain Pin Safety — structurally impossible to drive high
nodes.rationale: I2C and open-drain-mode pins must never actively drive high; enforced by hardware output stage configuration, not convention, so the RTL makes the violation structurally impossible rather than just discouraged.

nodes.label: Host Configuration Interface — SPI-like, not a general CPU
nodes.rationale: Deliberately not a general-purpose CPU — a full CPU for configuration would eat area budget better spent on reaction cells and the engine, and would reintroduce the 'generic processor with GPIO instructions' architecture explicitly rejected in SPEC.md §4.

nodes.label: Exclusive Pin Ownership — no two contexts drive same pin
nodes.rationale: Statically verified at compile time so it is a provable property, not a runtime hope — required because simultaneous pin ownership causes direct hardware contention.
nodes.norm_label: exclusive pin ownership — no two contexts drive same pin

nodes.label: Phase 0/1 Repository Setup
nodes.rationale: Repository was at Phase 0/1 setup stage; Tiny Tapeout toolchain and full Chimaera implementation were not yet present. Project was renamed from template to Chimaera and top-level module aligned.

nodes.label: Phase 2 UART Slice Development Start
nodes.rationale: Cocotb could not run locally due to missing install; toolchain is CI-only. Work moved to first hardware slice using Icarus Verilog for fast local checks. Scaffold adder replaced by UART RX/echo-TX design. Non-reentrant loop counter in testbench tasks caused false stop-bit failure; fixed by making tasks automatic rather than changing RTL.

nodes.label: Repository Commit and Attribution Policy
nodes.rationale: Policy established: work must be split into focused local commits without AI contributor attribution; agent must stop and announce when commits are ready rather than pushing automatically.
